gloss: to devise; to come up with an idea; to find a way

definitions.gloss: to devise; to come up with a creative solution; to find a way; to think of a good idea
definitions.explanation: To use ingenuity and creative thinking to find a better way of doing something or to solve a problem. Implies thoughtful effort and resourcefulness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{工夫|くふう}する。
examples.english: To come up with creative ways of cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{工夫|くふう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm finding ways to use my time effectively.

examples.english: We need to devise teaching methods so that children can study enjoyably.

notes:
A very positive word implying resourcefulness, ingenuity, and making the best of a situation. The noun ⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧ alone means a clever idea or device.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らす→工夫を凝らす：26076_kufuuwokorasu⟧ — to elaborate, to put great thought into
- ⟦{工夫|くふう}を{重|かさ}ねる→工夫を重ねる：25785_kufuuwokasaneru⟧ — to make repeated improvements
- ⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧ — depending on how you work at it
- いろいろ{工夫|くふう}する — to try various creative approaches

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ — to think; general thinking, not specifically creative problem-solving
- ⟦{発明|はつめい}→発明：01495_hatsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to invent; implies creating something entirely new
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ — to come up with ideas; more casual
